xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5233: Workspaces rail shows machine-made workspaces: rows carry no origin, and reaped issue rows never archive

plan.title: Workspaces rail shows machine-made workspaces: rows carry no origin, and reaped issue rows never archive
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: The projected surface is about 31 files across more than 6 path subsystems, but most are one-line call-site changes plus their tests and four doc files. Every slice depends on the same new column and write-door rule (origin-write-door), and the issue's three acceptance criteria (no machine-made rows on the rail, reaped rows archive, no dead rows after a rebuild run) only hold together: shipping the rail filter without the stamping creators would hide operator workspaces created by conversations, and stamping without the filter changes nothing visible. The reaper fix already shipped separately (e5cc8544749), which is the one piece that could stand alone.

narratives.Problem: The sidebar WORKSPACES rail and the Cmd-K workspaces scope treat every non-issue row as operator-made (isUserFacingWorkspace: kind !== 'issue' || isFavorite). Session Vault 'Continue here' and agents running `pan workspace new` write scratch rows indistinguishable from the operator's, so vault-<id8> and smoke-test workspaces fill the rail. A collapsed 'Pipeline worktrees 658' group duplicates the Projects section, and 645 of those issue rows point at deleted directories because the reaper never archived rows (fixed on main in e5cc8544749) and rebuild-workspaces' fallback asks a stale issues cache.
narratives.Proposal: Store a new workspaces.origin column (operator | pipeline | vault | agent), added and backfilled at schema top-up and stamped at the write door: issue rows are always pipeline, main rows always operator, scratch rows take the caller's origin through a new performWorkspaceCreate(intent, { origin }) argument. Session Vault stamps vault; `pan workspace new` stamps agent inside a managed session unless --origin operator; the dashboard create route derives origin from the request credential. The identity mirror carries origin so rebuild restores it. The rail and Cmd-K list origin === 'operator' or favorited rows and drop the pipeline count rows. `pan admin db rebuild-workspaces` archives issue rows whose directory is gone (skipping rows younger than 10 minutes) and terminal-issues.ts is deleted. Docs, the pan-workspace skill and a changelog entry describe the new behavior.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to the reaper (reap-issue-residue.ts); its row archival already shipped in e5cc8544749.
- No dead-row archival at dashboard boot; it runs only from `pan admin db rebuild-workspaces`.
- No UI to list, reveal or re-label non-operator workspaces; `pan workspace list --kind scratch` still lists them and favoriting still surfaces one.
- No CHECK constraint on workspaces.origin (SQLite cannot add one by ALTER); the writer's type is the guard.
- No change to GET /api/workspace-registry filtering; the API keeps returning every kind and origin.
- No change to the rail's Archived group or to includeArchived behavior.
- No origin field in WorkspaceCreateInput, ResolvedWorkspaceIntent, the /resolve response or toDryRunPayload.
- The request body of POST /api/workspace-registry must never set origin.
- No special handling for issue rows whose worktree migrated to a remote VM; they archive like any dead row and archive is reversible.
- No edit to the top of changelog.mdx and no raise of scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt.

autoDecisions.summary: The writer forces kind='main' rows to origin 'operator' as well as issue rows to 'pipeline' (D-1).
autoDecisions.rationale: FR-6 then holds for project creation, `pan workspace main` and the route's bootstrapMain without touching those callers, and a project's primary checkout is registered by the operator.

autoDecisions.summary: Origin reaches the writer as a second argument to performWorkspaceCreate, not as a field of the resolved intent (D-2).
autoDecisions.rationale: Origin is caller identity, not a resolution of the input; this keeps the nine-field dry-run payload that create-intent.test.ts pins and the /resolve response unchanged.

autoDecisions.summary: The create route maps credentials as in D-3: browser session, device, phone, operator-minted token and operator-acting machine are operator; per-agent token, agent-relaying machine, internal-token and connector are agent.
autoDecisions.rationale: The PRD's two-case rule mislabeled per-agent MCP tokens (PAN-4927) and agent-relaying machine links as operator; the full union is decided so the work agent makes no judgment call.

autoDecisions.summary: rowToWorkspace maps a NULL origin to 'pipeline' for issue rows and 'operator' otherwise (D-4).
autoDecisions.rationale: A blanket 'operator' fallback would put an issue row written by an older build onto the rail until the next backfill.

autoDecisions.summary: The identity mirror writes origin only when the source carries it, and all four rewrite sites pass it (D-6).
autoDecisions.rationale: writeWorkspaceIdentity builds its merged object field by field, so an unconditional origin key set to undefined would erase the stored value on archive or relocate.

autoDecisions.summary: archiveDeadIssueWorkspaces skips issue rows created less than 10 minutes ago, with an injectable now (D-7).
autoDecisions.rationale: workspace-manager/create.ts writes the issue row before `git worktree add`, so a rebuild run during a workspace creation would otherwise archive a live row; an injected clock keeps tests timer-free.

autoDecisions.summary: The schema backfill UPDATE is wrapped in try/catch that logs and continues (NFR-3).
autoDecisions.rationale: It runs on every database open; if the ALTER failed silently inside runSchemaTopUp, an unguarded UPDATE would throw on every open.

autoDecisions.summary: The vault name match is exact: vault-<8 lowercase hex> optionally followed by -2 through -9.
autoDecisions.rationale: That is exactly what createScratchWorkspace generates from a randomUUID; the original GLOB's trailing * was looser than FR-7's regex.

autoDecisions.summary: The rail's Archived group is left unchanged (D-9).
autoDecisions.rationale: The rail fetches /api/workspace-registry without includeArchived, so archived pipeline and vault rows never reach it.

autoDecisions.summary: Inside a managed session `pan workspace new` defaults to origin agent, and conversations acting for the operator pass --origin operator, documented in the CLI help, configuration/workspaces.mdx and the pan-workspace skill (D-8).
autoDecisions.rationale: The PRD names this rule; documenting it where conversations learn the command keeps operator-requested workspaces visible.

items.title: Add and backfill the workspaces.origin column at schema top-up

narrative.Action: PRD work item 1. Add a tab-indented `origin` text line after `kind` in the workspaces CREATE TABLE of drizzle/overdeck/0000_overdeck_init.sql. Extend tests/unit/lib/overdeck/workspace-tables.test.ts with the column-present case and the backfill case described in the PRD (seed NULL-origin rows via odb.raw(), closeOverdeckDatabase() then odb.raw() to re-run the top-up).
